newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp falls after downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp falls after downgrade.

text.p: Shares in The News Corp Ltd fell in early trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday after a fall in their ADR price following a downgrade by broker Goldman Sachs after poorer than expected first quarter results.
At 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT) News Corp shares were 10 cents or 1.44 percent lower at A$6.85 with 1.2 million shares traded.
